about: Proven by train-hearing on 1,800 mp3 clips (16 voices, 4 held out, half over music or noise) with vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15: each fix turned wrong commands right and broke none, and the held-out voices got better. Used only as extra tries when matching commands, never to rewrite what was said, and never for a word a house's own commands use.
